title: Phase Stability of Lead Using pyiron-workflow and the Quasiharmonic Approximation
description: A computational workflow for estimating the pressure- and temperature-dependent phase stability of pure lead (Pb). It compares FCC, HCP and BCC structures by calculating quasiharmonic Helmholtz free energies over volume grids, minimising F(V,T) + PV to obtain Gibbs free energies, and interpolating free-energy crossovers to estimate FCC/HCP and HCP/BCC phase boundaries. The calculations use an EAM interatomic potential and pyiron-workflow with ASE and phonon-related atomistic tools.
steps: Generate FCC, HCP and BCC lead structures at initial volume estimates
Build reusable Gibbs-free-energy workflows for pressure sweeps
Calculate quasiharmonic free energies over volume and temperature grids
Minimise F(V,T) + PV to obtain Gibbs free energies
Compare FCC/HCP and HCP/BCC Gibbs free-energy differences
Interpolate free-energy crossovers to estimate phase boundaries
